EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 3(1) of the Extradition Law, No. 8 of 1977, I, Maithreepala Sirisena,President do by this Order declare that, since a Treaty was signed at Saint Petersburg on the 28th day of May 2015 betweenthe Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation, a foreign state, in order to establish a bilaterallegal mechanism governing the transfer of persons subject to prosecution and sentenced persons and to improve the efficiencyof justice which would develop co-operation between the State Parties to the Treaty in the prevention of offences andinflict of punishment in respect of such offences and that the parties to the Treaty undertake to extradite to each other, uponrequest and subject to the provisions of the Treaty, the persons who are found within the territories of the respective StateParties for prosecution or execution of sentences ; and that the provisions of such Treaty is in conformity with the provisionsof Section 4 of the Extradition Law No. 8 of 1977 ; the provisions of the said Law No. 8 of 1977 shall apply in respect ofsuch foreign State, subject to such modification, limitation or condition as specified in the Treaty.
